reason: Conversation 2 correctly explained 22E as a fridge/evaporator fan fault, linked the scraping sound and frost to ice on the fan blades, raised the unplugged manual defrost as the temporary fix, and escalated to an engineer with sensible food-preservation advice. Its flaws (muddled line about not needing the 24h unplug, odd 'listen for hiss at night' check, asserting the defrost component 'has failed' before a defrost test, no warranty question) are real but secondary. Conversation 1 never told the homeowner what 22E means, ran a generic script of door/settings/vent/seal checks, repeated itself twice when the customer had already answered, and after ten turns still hadn't reached a diagnosis, a defrost suggestion or an escalation.
